title: Happy mouse
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx="33" cy="30" r="14" fill="#ff9ec4"/>
  <circle cx="67" cy="30" r="14" fill="#ff9ec4"/>
  <circle cx="33" cy="30" r="8" fill="#ffd6e7"/>
  <circle cx="67" cy="30" r="8" fill="#ffd6e7"/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="72" rx="27" ry="22" fill="#9a9af0"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="76" rx="18" ry="14" fill="#c5c5ff"/>

  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="46" r="24" fill="#b8b8ff"/>

  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx="32" cy="52" r="6" fill="#ffb3d1"/>
  <circle cx="68" cy="52" r="6" fill="#ffb3d1"/>

  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="41" cy="43" rx="4.5" ry="5.5" fill="#2a1a5e"/>
  <ellipse cx="59" cy="43" rx="4.5" ry="5.5" fill="#2a1a5e"/>
  <circle cx="42.5" cy="41.5" r="1.8" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="60.5" cy="41.5" r="1.8" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="53" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#ff6fa8"/>

  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M42 58 Q50 66 58 58" fill="none" stroke="#7a5bd6" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M46 62 Q50 65 54 62" fill="none" stroke="#7a5bd6" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- whiskers -->
  <line x1="22" y1="50" x2="36" y2="53" stroke="#d0d0ff" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="21" y1="57" x2="35" y2="57" stroke="#d0d0ff" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="23" y1="64" x2="36" y2="61" stroke="#d0d0ff" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="78" y1="50" x2="64" y2="53" stroke="#d0d0ff" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="79" y1="57" x2="65" y2="57" stroke="#d0d0ff" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="77" y1="64" x2="64" y2="61" stroke="#d0d0ff" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- little paws -->
  <ellipse cx="34" cy="90" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#c5c5ff"/>
  <ellipse cx="66" cy="90" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#c5c5ff"/>

  <!-- tail -->
  <path d="M77 76 Q92 70 86 58 Q82 50 88 46" fill="none" stroke="#ff9ec4" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
